result.title: OpenAI just broke physics...
result.description:
OpenAI says its AI has disproved the Exponential Time Hypothesis, challenging a barrier that shaped decades of computer science. Could there be shortcuts through problems we thought were impossibly hard? We unpack the connection to P versus NP, what a practical breakthrough could mean for encryption and AI, and the idea of a “cheat code” to the universe.
